customers.evidence: enabling affordable coverage, simplifying the health care experience and delivering access to high-quality care

employees.evidence: creating a culture where all team members are appreciated, valued and able to reach their full potential

integrity.evidence: developed strong and effective governance practices through compliance, board diversity and independence, a commitment to ethics and integrity

result.analyst_notes: Factual and declarative, with aspirational headlines such as Committed to Advancing Health Equity. Uses first-person plural (we, our) throughout. Governance and health equity lead the page, with employees and customers addressed through culture and access/affordability language. Commitments are mostly stated absolutely; the governance claim rests on a 40-year track record rather than future pledges.
